description: Regional automated job-search schedules for Chief's Career department. Schedules run BOUNDED DRY-RUN scans only: they never write to a tracker and never submit anything. Tracker writes stay an explicit, backed-up, approval-gated step (career_ops_cli.py write --apply).
overlap_policy: Tasks are staggered and each writes a distinct run-health file, so overlapping runs cannot duplicate rows: dry-run scans never mutate state at all.

uk.notes: Wires the existing UK lane (portals.yml + data/pipeline.md + data/scan-history.tsv). Matches the historical ~23:48 local run window recorded in data/scan-runs.tsv.

dubai.notes: Dubai lane config is NOT present in the Career Ops install (only the UK portals.yml exists and data/dubai-shortlist-history.md is the Dubai ledger). The runner refuses to execute rather than scanning UK portals under a Dubai label, and records the dependency. Owned by the pending regional-job-search task.

japan.notes: Japan lane config missing; same fail-safe as Dubai. Ledger: data/japan-shortlist-history.md.

singapore.notes: Singapore lane config missing; same fail-safe as Dubai. Ledger: data/singapore-shortlist-history.md.
